limitations: Native results determine possession and scores; localCatch means a BallTouched-change callback, not server acceptance. Numeric attribute provenance was unavailable in this release.
Each WR failure and opponent catch/point is included; DB Swatted is counted separately as a defensive stop. No DB Incomplete occurred in this window.
Forfeit winner is not inferred from the score.
An observed jump or positive sampled contact margin is not proof of a successful server claim.
Wins do not mean perfect play: failed WR passes and opponent touchdowns remain. No general win rate or causal release improvement is established.
privacy: No names, player/account/installation IDs, raw coordinates/states, credentials or native source.
